7. CREDITS AND COPYRIGHT
========================

Xenon ~Mugen no Shitai~
  Copyright (C) 1994 C's Ware. The story, text, pictures, music and sound
  effects are the work of C's Ware and remain their property.

  This is an unofficial fan port. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by
  C's Ware or any successor.

English translation
  From the Xenon PC-98 translation project,
  https://github.com/OldCorpo/Xenon-PC98-Tools
    OldCorpo     translation completion, tools
    dvo          proofreading and translation improvements
    Laukku       proofreading
    Asterix      proofreading
    Xanderzone   testing, support
    Fuzion       testing, support
  based on the original work of HempTL, siriusxiv, esperknight,
  MulletDonkey and OmBadai.
  This port uses a revised copy of that translation with later
  corrections. The menus of DATA LOAD, LADY'S ROOM and MUSIC MODE and the
  system menu, which the project did not translate, were translated for
  this port.

Polish translation
  Translated for this port from the Japanese original. The menus and
  the system menu were translated for this port as well.

The engine
  A new program written from scratch for this port. It reproduces
  the behaviour of the original PC-98 engine, AGS.EXE, which was studied
  by reverse engineering. None of the original program code is used.
  The music player is a new implementation that plays the game's songs,
  which are in the format of PMD, the PC-98 music driver by M. Kajihara
  (KAJA). The FM and SSG sound chip emulation is also new and written
  for the 68040.

Fonts
  The text is drawn with the X11 bitmap fonts "jiskan16" (from JIS
  X 9051-1984, by permission to use), "8x16rk" and "8x16" (Sony). The
  Polish letters were drawn for this port in the style of "8x16". The
  PC-98's built-in kanji font is not used. The Sony fonts come with
  this notice:
